column3: “A lord of rage” is rendered “wrathful,” and “maintaining” “reserves wrath.”
“Long of angers” is rendered “slow to anger”; NASB supplies “the guilty,” and renders “cloud” as “clouds” and “dust of his feet” as “dust beneath His feet.”
“Blossom” is rendered “blossoms”; the Hebrew perfect “made dry” is rendered as present.
“From him” is rendered “because of Him,” “melt” “dissolve,” and “lifted up” “is upheaved.”
“Its place” is rendered “its site,” and “pursue darkness” “pursue … into darkness.”
“For to thorns interwoven” is rendered “Like tangled thorns,” and “full” “completely”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
“A counselor of worthlessness” is rendered “A wicked counselor.”
“Complete” is rendered “at full strength”; NASB supplies “they are” and “Even so.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Not it will be sown from your name” is rendered “Your name will no longer be perpetuated,” and “insignificant” “contemptible”; “I will make your grave” is rendered “I will prepare your grave.”
MT 2:1. “Bears news” is rendered “brings good news”; “a worthless person” is rendered “the wicked one.”
